_meta.paper: Barndorff-Nielsen, O.E. & Shephard, N. (2006) 'Econometrics of Testing for Jumps in Financial Economics Using Bipower Variation', Journal of Financial Econometrics, 4(1), pp. 1-30
_meta.equation: Theorem 2: Z_BNS = (RV - BPV) / sqrt(theta * RTQ / M), where theta = pi^2/4 + pi - 5
_meta.null_distribution: Z_BNS ~ N(0,1) under H0: no jumps
_meta.tolerance: rel=1e-10 for Z-stat formula, abs=0.001 for theta constant

no_jump_property.description: Pure Gaussian returns (no jump component) should produce Z close to 0 in expectation
no_jump_property.test_approach: Generate many Gaussian samples, verify Z is approximately standard normal

jump_detection_property.description: Adding a single large return (5+ sigma) should produce Z >> 3.09 (99.9% critical value)
